name: Securities Balance Transparency Report Status Advice V 01
definition: SCOPE||An account owner, such as a custodian, central securities depository, international securities depository or transfer agent, sends the SecuritiesBalanceTransparencyReportStatusAdvice message in response to a SecuritiesBalanceTransparencyReport, to accept or reject the statement of holdings as sent in a SecuritiesBalanceTransparencyReport.||USAGE|The SecuritiesBalanceTransparencyReportStatusAdvice is used to accept (Accepted), partially accept (Accepted With Exception) or reject (Rejected) a previously received SecuritiesBalanceTransparencyReport.
